'''Gomanes''' was a member of the [[Children of the Light]].

==Activities==
He came to the [[Two Rivers]] under the command of [[Dain Bornhald]].

He was killed in a "skirmish with [[Trollocs]]" while in a group commanded by [[Ordeith]].{{ref|[[Padan Fain]] in disguise}} This was the second time that Dain had sent some of his own men with Ordeith and his band of followers, and the second time his men were the only fatalities.{{ref/book|4|31}}

By his name, it is possible he was Tairen or Cairhienin, but it is not known for sure.
